'''Louse Progenitor''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Louse Progenitor}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Web Cannon
|Intent = Attack2, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (9;{{Asc2|9|10}}) damage. Applies 2 {{BD2|Frail}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Frail
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Curl and Grow
|Intent = Defend, Buff
|Effect = Gains (14;{{Asc2|8|18}}) {{KW2|Block}}. Gains (5;{{Asc2|9|7}}) {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block, Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Pounce
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (14;{{Asc2|9|16}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Louse Progenitor repeats a fixed three-move cycle: {{Int2|Louse Progenitor|Web Cannon}}, then {{Int2|Louse Progenitor|Curl and Grow}}, then {{Int2|Louse Progenitor|Pounce}}, and back to the start.

== Trivia ==
The Louse Progenitor appears to be an ancestor to the {{M|Red Louse}} and {{M|Green Louse}} in the original game.
